text:
anya: ACME corp POC blocked: calling embeddings returns 401 Invalid API key. We gave sk-acme-poc-2026 and they send X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc.

mike: Ask for the curl + which host their DNS resolves to. 401 usually key missing/disabled/region mismatch.

anya: Redacted sample:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-poc-2026" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response: {"error":"Invalid API key","code":401}

sam: infra-bot check?

infra-bot: log: [2026-03-10T10:05:00Z] key=sk-acme-poc-2026 action=auth-check result=not-found region=us-east-1

mike: Key exists in eu-west-1 but request hit us-east-1. Their corporate edge pins traffic to us-east-1. Two options: create temp presales key in us-east-1 or ask infra to route to eu-west-1.

anya: I created a short-lived key in us-east-1 bound to acme-poc and DM'd it. Command (internal): redwoodctl keys create --org acme --project acme-poc --region us-east-1 --scopes embeddings --ttl 12h --label "acme presales temp"

infra-bot: log: [2026-03-10T10:07:20Z] key=sk-acme-temp-55 created owner=anya region=us-east-1 bound_projects=["acme-poc"] ttl=12h

anya: Customer retried, now 200 and embeddings returned. :white_check_mark:

mike: Follow-ups: revoke old sk-acme-poc-2026, add region flag to sample repo, and include programmatic revoke snippet for their security questionnaire. Revoke example: curl -X DELETE https://control.redwood.ai/v1/keys/{key_id} -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>"

anya: Logged follow-ups in the deal doc. Closing.
